messages:
anna (PM): Kicking off a short thread to align on soft limits, proration, and overage handling for the next-quarter packaging push. Need a proposal we can take to GTM by EOD Friday.

mike (Eng): TL;DR: two levers — soft limits (grace window + advisory throttles) + burst credits. Soft limits are cheap to add but have UX/ops implications. :thinking:

rahul (Billing): We also need clear billing behavior. Customers hate surprise invoices. Proposal: show a projected overage estimate in console and email at 80% and 95% of committed usage, then bill monthly with optional proration for yearly contracts.

emma (Sales): +1 on the warnings. Also want an opt-in auto-topup for trial customers to avoid hard cutoffs during demos. Can we make that a checkbox?

sean (RevOps): We should quantify revenue impact. Two scenarios: (A) Soft limits only — lower churn but potential short-term revenue loss. (B) Hard limits + clear overage pricing — higher predictability. Need modeling by next Wed.

jess (Design): Console changes: insert a per-route soft-limit toggle, a timeline visualization for burst credits, and a compact messaging banner for projected overage. Small mockups later today.

mike (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```
// per-customer ring buffer for token usage
if (usage > soft_limit) {
  mark_advisory(); // 429 with Retry-After advisory header
  notify_console();
} else if (usage > hard_limit) {
  enforce_throttle(); // config: drop or queue
}
```
Behavior: advisory 429s *do not* count as billable overage; only usage past hard_limit is billed unless customer bought burst credits.

rahul (Billing): Important: advisory 429s must be logged separately and not increment usage counters. Otherwise finance can't reconcile. Also need invoice line items for "burst credits" and for "overage (per-token)".

anna (PM): Launch criteria draft — please comment:
- Product: console toggle + warning emails at 80/95% implemented
- Billing: billing lines + proration for annual (if midterm upgrade/downgrade)
- Eng: advisory 429s tracked separately, burst credits allocation API
- SLOs: <1% increase in 5xx from throttle logic
- Beta: roll to 5% of GA customers (mix of trial, paid, Dedicated)

emma (Sales): Add acceptance criteria: default behavior must be predictable for renewals (no retroactive charges). Sales to get a cookbook for negotiating burst-credit packages.

mike (Eng): Ops note: Need an escape hatch for incidents — ability to suspend soft-limits globally and push clients to fallback models. Will add a feature flag.

sean (RevOps): For pricing tiers, propose a "burst credit" SKU: X tokens per month, carryover allowed for 30 days, priced at $Y per million tokens. We'll model three buckets (small/med/large).

jess (Design): UX microcopy suggestion for advisory throttle:
"Usage has exceeded your soft limit. Requests may be delayed or rate-limited. View burst credit options or upgrade your quota."

rahul (Billing): Proration rules proposal:
- Mid-month upgrade: prorate remaining days on new plan credit
- Mid-year annual upgrade: pro-rate to next billing date and apply credit immediately
- Downgrades: schedule for next invoice cycle (no retroactive charge)

anna (PM): Risk register (quick):
- Confusing UX -> support load spike
- Unexpected billing disputes -> sales friction
- Engineering complexity -> rollout delays
Mitigations: docs + canned support responses + small beta cohort.

billing-bot: Created ticket #BILL-412: "Implement separate metric for advisory 429s" assigned to rahul.

mike (Eng): Proposed rollout plan:
1) Feature flag behind flag
2) Beta to 5% customers (auto-selected) for 2 weeks
3) Monitor advisory 429 rate, billing alerts, and support tickets
4) Expand to 25% if metrics stable, then GA
Metrics: support tickets per 1000 accounts, unexpected invoice disputes, advisory-429 rate, token revenue delta.

emma (Sales): Can we get a one-pager for AE playbook? I can draft if product + billing sign off.

anna (PM): Action items:
- mike: PR for advisory 429 + flag (due Tue)
- rahul: billing line items + proration spec (due Wed)
- jess: mockups + microcopy (EOD today)
- emma: AE playbook draft (Thu)
- sean: revenue scenarios (Wed)
I'll consolidate and send to GTM stakeholders Thurs morning.

mike (Eng): Quick Q: do we want advisory 429s to include a `x-soft-limit-remaining` header? Could help clients auto-backoff.

rahul (Billing): Yes include `X-SoftLimit-Remaining` and `X-BurstCredits-Remaining` headers. Also include machine-readable billing codes in header for downstream reconciliations.

anna (PM): Nice—ok. If no objections, we'll lock this as the plan and start execution. :thumbsup:

sean (RevOps): No objections from my side.

emma (Sales): Approved from GTM. I'll loop in Legal for contract language tweaks.

jess (Design): Uploading mocks to Figma — link in thread when ready.

billing-bot: Updated ticket #BILL-412 -> status: in progress.

anna (PM): Thanks team — will post the consolidated spec in #product-roadmap and ping stakeholders.
